decisions.evidence: R1 maker (round 1): 'Stores references only — it does not fetch/archive page content'. R1 client: 'Automatic page details when saving: title, description, favicon, and preview image, while still letting me edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker's v1 explicitly excludes metadata fetching, contradicting REF-BM-02; client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour incl. editability (REF-BM-03). Corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'does not fetch/archive page content' and 'Import/export and a browser-capture extension are out of scope'. R1 client: 'I also expect ... a preserved page snapshot, including keeping PDFs as PDFs.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. v1 diverges from REF-BM-24 (snapshot + PDF rule) by not archiving content; client supplies the conforming requirement. Corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec omits read-later (P1–P3 have no unread concept). R1 client: '"Read later" status and a separate unread view.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference read-later items absent from v1; client requests the missing requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has only delete-with-confirmation, no archive. R1 client: 'Reversible archiving with its own archive view, distinct from permanent deletion.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive/restore vs delete absent from v1; client requests missing reference requirement, explicitly distinguishing archive from delete. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker asks 'anything missing ... sorting options?' but the drafted spec has no sort. R1 client: 'Sorting, at least by date added and title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Sorting was in asked-about scope but absent from the spec; client requests the reference requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no duplicate handling. R1 client: 'Duplicate addresses should take me to edit the existing bookmark rather than create another copy.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-06 absent from v1; client requests the missing requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Import/export ... out of scope for v1' and asks 'Are the out-of-scope calls right (no accounts, no import/export ...)?' R1 client: 'I would like standard bookmark import/export in v1 so I can bring in an existing collection and take it with me later.' Format confirmed at R2 client ('standard browser HTML bookmark format ... work for me').
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker's explicit out-of-scope exclusion contradicts REF-BM-30/31; client rejects the exclusion. Corrective/negate. R2 format clarification is the linked disposition of the same requirement — not double-counted.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no notes field. R1 client: 'I also expect saved notes'. Delivered R5 as US5 'free-form notes, searchable'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Notes absent from v1; client requests the missing reference requirement. Corrective/extend (markdown-rendering sub-aspect of REF-BM-23 not separately surfaced).

decisions.evidence: Tag entry presented across R1 (P1 tags) / R4 tasks / R5 (assign tags) with no autocomplete; client never mentions tag autocomplete through R5 final acceptance ('I accept this version').
decisions.note: REF-BM-10 (existing-tag autocomplete) absent from presented scope and delivery; passed without any client expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker search: 'Keyword search (title/address/description/notes/tags), tag filter' — no #tag query syntax. Client never raises it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-14 (#tag search syntax) absent; tag filtering exists but not the inline #tag operator. Passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R1–R5 search described only as keyword search; no AND/OR/NOT, parentheses, or quoted-phrase exact match presented or delivered. Client never raises it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-15/16 (boolean/parenthesised operators, quoted-phrase exact match) absent from presented scope and delivery; passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No multi-select/bulk actions appear in any maker presentation (R1 spec, R4 tasks, R5 report) nor in any client message.
decisions.note: REF-BM-20/21 (bulk multi-select actions and apply-to-current-filter) absent throughout; passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R2/R3/R5 snapshot scope is local MHTML + PDF passthrough only; Internet Archive snapshotting never mentioned by maker or client.
decisions.note: REF-BM-25 (Internet Archive snapshot) absent; snapshot requirement was co-constructed (D3) but this sub-feature passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No 'bundle'/saved-filter concept in any maker presentation or client message across R1–R5.
decisions.note: REF-BM-29 (bundles = saved search+tag filter) absent throughout; passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No user/display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) presented (R1–R5) or requested by client. Sort exists as a control but no persisted display settings entity.
decisions.note: REF-BM-32 (personal display settings) absent from presented scope and delivery; passed without expression. Unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Search presented as 'keyword search' (R1/R5); case-sensitivity never stated by maker and never raised by client.
decisions.note: Cannot establish divergence — case-insensitive matching may be the default implementation (equivalent). Recorded as unresolved with diverged=null; excluded from the denominator.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P1: 'add a link by its address'; delivered R5 US1.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (save by URL). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'rename, re-tag, and delete'; R5 edit fields incl. tags/notes.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (edit bookmark fields). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3: 'delete bookmarks (with a delete confirmation)'; R5 US6 permanent delete with confirmation.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (delete with confirmation). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 spec exposes title/address/description/tags in the list; favicon added via the D1 metadata correction; R5 readable list.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (readability-first list). Favicon dependency handled under the REF-BM-02/03 correction. not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P1 assign tags; R1 client 'Tags are enough'; R5 assign tags.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (assign one or more tags). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2 'filter by tag'; R5 US3 tag filter.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (filter to a tag). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker: 'Keyword search (title/address/description/notes/tags)'. Covers title/description/note/url per REF-BM-12.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision (full-text search over title/desc/note/url). not_divergent (advanced-syntax sub-behaviours tracked separately as REF-BM-13/14/15/16).
